title: Watch: Karaoke and butterflies - US cities celebrate Dolly Parton Day
summary: The day is observed on 25 September, or 9/25, as a nod to the late Queen of Country's hit song 9 to 5.

blocks.text: States across the US celebrated Dolly Parton Day with karaoke, pink lights, live music and book drives.
The day is observed on 25 September, or 9/25, as a nod to the late Queen of Country's hit song 9 to 5.
